Hello,

I've been trying to get SparkR running on a CDH 5.1.2 cluster with YARN. I've been able to build it with YARN support by including 

"org.apache.spark" % "spark-core_2.10" % "1.0.0-cdh5.1.2"

and 

"org.apache.spark" %% "spark-yarn" % "1.0.0-cdh5.1.2"

as build dependencies in pkg/src/build.sbt and running SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.3.0-cdh5.1.2 ./install-dev.sh, however I still am unable to run the pi.R example. I get the following output

$ ./sparkR examples/pi.R yarn-cluster
Loading required package: methods
Loading required package: rJava
[SparkR] Initializing with classpath /home/msa/SparkR-pkg/lib/SparkR/sparkr-assembly-0.1.jar

14/09/19 23:21:20 INFO Slf4jLogger: Slf4jLogger started
14/09/19 23:21:21 WARN NativeCodeLoader: Unable to load native-hadoop library for your platform... using builtin-java classes where applicable

and the process simply hangs. I see no apps running in YARN.

I'm stumped. Any ideas how to debug this?
